name: Marcus (Roman legionary, validation)
description: Legionary of the early 2nd century AD (Trajanic, c. AD 100-115): lorica segmentata over a red wool tunic, focale scarf, Imperial-type helmet with cheek and neck guards (no crest in battle), cingulum belt with studded apron, gladius on the right hip, curved rectangular scutum, hobnailed caligae. Clean-shaven, cropped dark hair. Alert, economical movement.

references: Wikipedia: Lorica segmentata (in use c. early 1st - mid 3rd c. AD)
uncertain: tunic colour (red and undyed both attested)
shield blazon (generic boss and bars used)
